Prerequisite(s): Airy Step, character level 9, aegyl

Benefit: Your bonus on saves against effects with the wind or lightning descriptors and effects that deal wind or lightning damage increases to +4. In addition, your fly speed increases to 120 feet (good maneuverability), as long as they do not carry more than a Medium load, are not wearing plate armor, and are not fatigued or exhausted. If aegyls carry a heavy load or wear plate armor, their flight speed drops to 60 feet with average maneuverability.
